name: EPIC 211501926

text.card: A red giant 4,707 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.87 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,736 K at its surface.
